Features Sleeps Three Exterior Storage Aurora Base Package Aurora Comfort and Construction Package GE Kitchen Suite and Appliance Package More About This RV This lightweight travel trailer includes everything you need for comfortable camping trips at the lake. A front queen bed provides a great night's rest, and there is a booth dinette ideal to share meals. You'll appreciate the bedroom storage and overhead shelf, along with an overhead shelf with bins over the sofa to keep your space tidy. The rear corner kitchen includes a two burner gas range and microwave oven, and the private bath is conveniently located in the other rear corner! Comfortability, usability, and quality is what you will find in each one of these Forest River Aurora Light travel trailers! They are designed with a superior build and packed full with industry leading, functional, and distinctive standard features. The diamond plate rock guard will protect your unit from road debris and the nitrogen filled radial tires, which keep their pressure longer, offer better fuel economy. You will also find upgraded JBL Elite exterior speaker outside, an electric awning with multicolor lights and remote, plus flush mount baggage doors for easy packing. The interiors are beautifully designed with matte black kitchen and bath faucets, black nightshades in the living room, and GE kitchen appliances!
